questions.question: What does "rainstorm" mean?
questions.answer: It means a sudden, heavy fall of rain.

questions.question: What damage can a flood do?
questions.answer: It can destroy buildings, damage cars and hurt people.

questions.question: Why do you think Bright House needs cleaning supplies?
questions.answer: It is because the shelter is wet and dirty after the flood. It needs cleaning supplies to clean up the shelter.
